### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Anthropic cuts Claude pricing 75% ahead of planned $2 trillion IPO valuation
Anthropic cut Claude cache read pricing 75% to $0.25 per million tokens, matching OpenAI's base pricing as the company prepares for an IPO valued at up to $2 trillion. The company reported $4.6 billion 2025 revenue (12x 2024) but a $42 billion loss, with $518 billion in committed computing capacity.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Cache read pricing cut 75%: $1 to $0.25 per million tokens</li>
<li>Base pricing: $10 input, $50 output per million tokens (matches GPT-6 Astra)</li>
<li>2025 revenue: $4.6 billion; operating loss: &gt;$8 billion</li>
<li>IPO targeted at $2 trillion valuation, November 2026 listing</li>
</ul>

## Security

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7.5/10" aria-label="Importance 7.5 of 10">7.5</span> Chinese Hacker Used Anthropic's Claude AI to Steal South Korean Bank Data, CrowdStrike Reports
CrowdStrike identified a suspected 26-year-old Chinese attacker who used Anthropic's Claude AI and the ARTEX penetration-testing tool to compromise at least nine South Korean banks. The attacker queried Claude on selling stolen data and asked it to create a resume containing personal details.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Suspect: 26-year-old, Guangdong province, Maoming location</li>
<li>At least 9 South Korean banks targeted, late September to early October 2026</li>
<li>Shinhan Bank: ~25,000 customer records compromised</li>
<li>KB Kookmin Bank: 119 customer records leaked</li>
</ul>

Sources: [Benzinga](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQcUw2bmsxdHlrQzExbzJvX1BaT05xSmVwMDlUa2VMVldfOW5paWtGLUJjaTIwby1PUldNUVhXME0yUWpTQ3UxRXlEY21CQXotVWdJTFJDS2NzT0l0TFk2UkpCM2xwVy1UYUxUTVZ3Q2RndUs5X3N5Z0NyOFVqVk4yRTlEQkxpcy1FSXZwWDdjYmsyanR6aExNMU0xYTRpN3BKWlBiVkdGTzNoT0k?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-research">AI Web Searched</span>

## Competition

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> OpenAI gaining competitive ground on Anthropic in AI pricing war
OpenAI is gaining competitive ground on Anthropic in the AI pricing war. Chinese competitor DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash narrowed the performance gap to 3% on benchmarks, down from 9% in May, driving U.S. companies to cut prices as they pursue IPOs.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>DeepSeek V4.1 Flash LiveBench score: 81.1 vs Anthropic 83.4 (3% gap)</li>
<li>Performance gap narrowed from 9% in May, 15% earlier in year</li>
<li>Chinese models&#x27; lower costs pressuring U.S. pricing</li>
<li>Both companies pursuing IPOs, requiring sustainable business models</li>
</ul>
